We believe that remote-first, globally distributed engineering teams are the future. Attract and serve enterprise-level clients — by strengthening delivery quality, project reliability, and compliance to handle complex, high-stakes projects. Deliver speed, quality, and flexibility at scale — ensuring clients get vetted, ready-to-interview talent and high-performing teams with exceptional turnaround time. Sustain rapid, high-quality growth — continuing our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing tech companies while preserving performance, culture, and delivery excellence. Giving back is part of our DNA. We donate around 10% of the revenue to support vulnerable groups — including children, women, refugees — and invests in education programs for young students and future IT professionals. If you’re motivated by scale, impact, complex projects, and global collaboration, Index.dev is the kind of place where your efforts will be amplified. review_candidates.title: Data Analyst – Middle
review_candidates.description: Overview SOFTSWISS is expanding its analytics team and is looking for a Data Analyst to help gain full visibility into the performance of our products. The role is focused on analysing key product and business metrics, user behaviour, and performance changes. We are looking for an analyst who can work confidently with data, identify meaningful insights, and translate them into clear recommendations for product and business teams. Purpose of the role In this role, you will analyse product and business metrics, study user behaviour across different stages of the customer journey, and uncover the root causes behind performance changes. Your insights will support better product and business decisions. You will work with SQL and BI tools to prepare data, build reporting, investigate anomalies, and provide ad-hoc analytical support to stakeholders. Key responsibilities: Analyse key product and business metrics, including user activity, retention, conversion, revenue-related metrics, and other core KPIs. Study user behaviour across the customer journey through cohort, funnel, and lifecycle analysis. Work with databases: extract, join, and prepare data for analysis using SQL. Build and maintain reporting and BI dashboards (preferably in Tableau) for product and management needs. Investigate anomalies and performance deviations — identify problems and diagnose their root causes. Run ad-hoc analyses for product and leadership teams to support tactical and strategic decisions. Monitor data quality and consistency across product and financial data. Document metric definitions, analytical approaches, and key findings. Required Experience: 3+ years as a Data Analyst / Product Analyst / Operations Analyst. Strong analytical thinking and the ability to interpret numbers in a business context. Solid understanding of core analytics concepts: funnels, cohorts, retention, and lifecycle metrics. Ability to translate business questions into analytical tasks and explain results clearly to non-technical stakeholders. SQL: confident reading and writing analytical queries (joins, aggregations, window functions). Experience with BI tools, ideally Tableau. Fluent Russian, both spoken and written. English B2, both spoken and written. Nice to have: Experience in iGaming / fintech / B2B SaaS. Understanding of product and business unit economics, including revenue drivers, conversion, retention, customer value, and profitability metrics. Basic statistics: confidence intervals, p-values, common pitfalls in experiment interpretation. Experience with ClickHouse. Python for analytics. Our Benefits: Full-time work opportunities Private insurance An additional Day Off (1) per calendar year Sports program compensation Comprehensive Mental Health Programme Free online English lessons with native speakers Generous referral program Training, internal workshops, and participation in international professional conferences and corporate events
